```yaml
name: Validate Dotfiles

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y fish zsh shellcheck stow
          # Install Linuxbrew for Brewfile validation
          sh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
          echo 'eval "$(/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew shellenv)"' >> $GITHUB_ENV
          eval "$(/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew shellenv)"

      - name: Shellcheck linting
        run: |
          shopt -s nullglob
          files=( $(git ls-files '*.sh') )
          if [ ${#files[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            shellcheck "${files[@]}"
          else
            echo "No shell scripts to lint."
          fi

      - name: Fish syntax validation
        run: |
          shopt -s nullglob
          fish_files=( $(git ls-files '*.fish') )
          if [ ${#fish_files[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            fish --syntax-check "${fish_files[@]}"
          else
            echo "No Fish scripts to validate."
          fi

      - name: Zsh syntax validation
        run: |
          shopt -s nullglob
          zsh_files=( $(git ls-files '*.zsh') )
          if [ ${#zsh_files[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            zsh -n "${zsh_files[@]}"
          else
            echo "No Zsh scripts to validate."
          fi

      - name: Stow symlink integrity check
        run: |
          stow -t . --no-folding --verbose --check

      - name: Brewfile dependency check
        run: |
          if [ -f Brewfile ]; then
            brew bundle check
          else
            echo "No Brewfile found; skipping dependency check."
          fi

      - name: Run custom validation script
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/validate.sh
          ./scripts/validate.sh
```
